 Warriors could get major boost sooner than expected amid great start 
 2026-11-08 16:03 
 Riding a seven-game winning streak led by 38-year-old Stephen Curry, the Golden State Warriors have found their rhythm. Their momentum could soon grow even stronger, with Jimmy Butler potentially returning from his ACL injury ahead of schedule following recent intensive workouts.
 Credit: IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect - Scanpix 
 Credit IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect - Scanpix 
 Credit IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect - Scanpix

 The Golden State Warriors have surprised many fans with their turnaround at the start of the 2026-27 NBA season.

 After losing the first three games, the Dubs have recorded seven straight victories behind impressive offensive output from 38-year-old Stephen Curry .
 The legendary guard is averaging 31.3 points, 4.0 rebounds and 4.6 assists, shooting 44.7% from beyond the arc. His point average is only behind Luka Doncic 's wild 40.1 points per game.
 Potential boost coming sooner than expected?
 While it seems that the Warriors have found their rhythm they could get a major boost quite soon with Jimmy Butler coming back from his ACL tear sooner than expected.
 Jimmy Butler Credit IMAGN IMAGES via Reuters Connect-Scanpix In the beginning of October, Steve Kerr dropped February as a potential return timeline for Butler alongside Moses Moody , who has also missed a lot of time with a ruptured patellar tendon.
 However, before Golden State's game on Saturday, Kerr indicated that Butler had recently worked out in a full Warriors uniform and the player later showed up to the locker room in a full sweat, meaning that his recovery is rapidly ramping up, via Warriors reporter Kenzo Fukuda .
 Butler's return would give a major boost to Golden State as up until his injury in the 2025-26 season, the forward showed terrific performance, averaging 20.0 points, 5.6 rebounds, 4.9 assists and 1.5 steals, while shooting 37.6% from three.
 There is doubt that Butler can return to his previous form as he is 37 years old and could have potentially lost some of his speed and athleticism, theough the player himself has assured that people will be shocked how well he will come back.
